title: 李开复：AI抢工作？蓝领比白领更安全，因为机器人还没跟上
speaker: Kai-Fu Lee

segments.en: The big concern I would have is just letting AI do these tactical tasks doesn't move the dial for the company.
segments.zh: 我最大的担忧是，只让AI做这些战术性任务，并不能真正推动公司前进。

segments.en: So I guess in that sense, how do we need to be thinking about employment and manpower and manpower resource? To what extent, how close are we from being replaced by agents, you and me, for example?
segments.zh: 那么从这个角度，我们该如何看待就业和人力资源？我们离被智能体取代还有多近，比如你和我？

segments.en: Well, if we think about it as a fixed pie, most people are very close to being replaced. But it's not a fixed pie because we're going to grow the GDP two, three, four or five times in the next five years.
segments.zh: 如果把它看成固定大小的饼，大多数人确实离被取代很近。但饼不是固定的，因为未来五年GDP会增长两到五倍。

segments.en: Right. And when that happens, the pie is bigger. There's more things for people to do. People probably need to find a different job, and maybe they need to do more work that connects with other people.
segments.zh: 对。当这种情况发生，饼更大了，人们有更多事可做。人们可能需要找不同的工作，也许需要做更多与人连接的工作。

segments.en: Maybe they need to find jobs that don't have a close form solution. And also, I think blue color work is safer a little bit longer, actually, than most white color work. Why is that? Because AI doesn't yet have a strong robotic capability.
segments.zh: 也许他们需要找没有封闭解的工作。而且我认为蓝领工作实际上比大多数白领工作安全得更久一些。为什么？因为AI还没有强大的机器人能力。

segments.en: This embodied AI robotics is still a few years away. Right. But the AI agents that can do the task of most workers who do cognitive tasks is here now.
segments.zh: 具身智能机器人还需要几年。对。但能完成大多数认知型工作者任务的AI智能体，现在已经来了。

segments.en: Okay. Now, the concept of, I guess you, since you brought up embodied AI, for you and me, how we express, how we interact with the technology for most people is the mobile phone.
segments.zh: 好。既然你提到具身智能，那么对大多数人来说，我们表达和互动技术的方式就是手机。
